title: Part 3 簡短對話
summary: 聽兩人對話，回答地點、問題和下一步。

steps.title: Part 3 是什麼
body: Part 3 會聽一段兩到三人的對話，每段對話有 3 題。考試時題目和選項會印在題本上。
秘訣：聽之前先看題目，知道要聽「在哪裡、什麼問題、接下來做什麼」。

steps.title: 常見問法
body: 這三種問法幾乎每段對話都會出現：

head: 題目
中文
要聽什麼
rows: Where most likely are the speakers?
What will the woman do next?

steps.tip: 答案常常是對話內容「換句話說」，例如 doesn't work 換成 is broken。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 先看題目，再按 ▶ 聽對話。每段對話有 3 題。

questions.explanation:
退貨（return）、收據（receipt）都表示在商店。
逐字稿：W: Hi, I'd like to return this printer. It doesn't work.　M: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?　W: Yes, here it is. I bought it last Friday.　M: Okay. Would you like a new one or your money back?　W: A new one, please.
questions.sentence: Where most likely are the speakers?

questions.explanation:
It doesn't work. 印表機壞了。
逐字稿：W: Hi, I'd like to return this printer. It doesn't work.　M: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?　W: Yes, here it is. I bought it last Friday.　M: Okay. Would you like a new one or your money back?　W: A new one, please.

A new one, please. 她要換一台新的。
逐字稿：W: Hi, I'd like to return this printer. It doesn't work.　M: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?　W: Yes, here it is. I bought it last Friday.　M: Okay. Would you like a new one or your money back?　W: A new one, please.

questions.prompt: 說話者最可能在哪裡工作？
questions.explanation:
和客戶（client）開會、會議室，表示在辦公室。
逐字稿：M: Good morning, Lisa. Are you ready for the meeting with the client?　W: Almost. But the projector in Room A isn't working.　M: Let's use Room B, then. I'll tell the client.　W: Great. I'll move our things there now.
questions.sentence: Where most likely do the speakers work?

questions.explanation:
The projector in Room A isn't working. 投影機壞了。
逐字稿：M: Good morning, Lisa. Are you ready for the meeting with the client?　W: Almost. But the projector in Room A isn't working.　M: Let's use Room B, then. I'll tell the client.　W: Great. I'll move our things there now.

I'll move our things there now. there 指 Room B。打給客戶的是男子。
逐字稿：M: Good morning, Lisa. Are you ready for the meeting with the client?　W: Almost. But the projector in Room A isn't working.　M: Let's use Room B, then. I'll tell the client.　W: Great. I'll move our things there now.
questions.sentence: What will the woman do next?

steps.title: 延伸練習：換句話說
steps.intro: 多益很愛換句話說，練習看看。

questions.prompt: It doesn't work. 換句話說是哪一句？
questions.explanation: doesn't work（不能用）＝ is broken（壞了）。
get your money back：拿回你的錢，也就是退款。
